findings.text: §2 defines the family as "the pattern family the repository already defines for documentation, with the locus held fixed", but the definition it names (imas_codex/standard_names/families.py:422-447, documented at docs/evidence/fragments/sn-catalog-grouping/scg-family-definition.html) holds only the entity locus invariant and lists `position`, `geometry` and `region` as variation axes, keeping `electron_temperature` and `electron_temperature_at_magnetic_axis` family-mates; the narrowing is stated once, in §2's prose, while §3's read-back ("over every live name lists zero families whose members carry more than one `physics_domain`", line 68) and §4's export gate ("any family it would publish across more than one domain file", line 78, with the done-when at line 82 requiring the repaired graph to report none) speak of "family" without it — so a node reading §3 or §4 alone, or reaching for the repository's own `fetch_pattern_family`, groups locus-different siblings into one family and then demands they share a domain, which §2 explicitly forbids ("a density at the pedestal top and the same density at the magnetic axis may belong to different domains").

findings.reason: §3's primary done-when fails on any family §2 reports undecided unless the plan says an undecided family is resolved by a lead correction or is itself an accepted exception, and neither section says it.
findings.text: §2 leaves an undecided family's members unwritten ("none of its members is written"), so members keep the incumbent domains that were split, while §3's zero-split gate allows only one exception, "families held split by a recorded lead correction that names the family" (line 68); an undecided family is therefore a family §3 must list as split and has no exception covering it, and §2 expands each family's option set by unioning its members' sources, which is a change that makes the confidence floor harder to clear.

findings.reason: the node either blocks awaiting a labeller or self-labels and the plan's headline accuracy comparison stops measuring anything, so the plan needs to name who labels (as it already names the lead for corrections) or state a fallback arm.
findings.text: the accuracy measure is taken "on at least 30 families of three or more members ... each given one domain by a reader who has not seen either decision", and no reader is assigned; a worker has necessarily seen the per-name decision (it is live) and will see the per-family one it builds, so it cannot label its own set without destroying the blindness the item exists to buy.
